AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVE
AbstractText.content: To investigate the association between polymorphism of rs3212986 in ERCC1 and susceptibility to preeclampsia in the Chinese Han population.

AbstractText.Label: STUDY DESIGN
AbstractText.content: Samples of 642 preeclampsia patients and 877 controls were genotyped for rs3212986 using TaqMan allele discrimination assays. The genetic and allelic distributions between the groups were compared by Pearson's χ2 test.

AbstractText.Label: RESULT
AbstractText.content: There was no difference in the genotypic and allelic distributions between cases and controls (P>0.05). Statistical difference in genotypic frequencies of rs3212986 was observed between early-onset and late-onset preeclampsia (χ2=6.985, P=0.030). When subdivided into TT/GG+GT groups, a significant difference was found between early-onset and late-onset preeclampsia (χ2=6.528, P=0.011, OR=2.011, 95%CI 1.167-3.465).

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: The polymorphisms of rs3212986 showed no association with the risk of preeclampsia in the Chinese Han population. However, the difference in the genotypic distribution between early-onset and late-onset preeclampsia suggest the need for future studies.
